result.reason: The awards feature satisfies the Feature Module Conventions. Structure: there is exactly one entry point (index.ts) which re-exports the entire public API (run as pickWinners, PickWinnersInput, and Award), with no consumer-facing imports of internal files; types live in the dedicated award-types.ts; the logic file is verb-first kebab-case (pick-winners.ts) and follows service conventions (single exported `run`, Results over exceptions with actionable consumer-grade error messages for invalid minReviews and empty standings). Cohesion: every file is reachable from index.ts through its import graph (no orphaned files), the directory serves a single capability (award selection), and the feature name 'awards' describes the capability rather than its implementation. No violations found.

The awards feature module fully satisfies all specification requirements. It has exactly one entry point (index.ts) that re-exports the public API, includes a dedicated types file (award-types.ts), uses verb-first kebab-case for logic files (pick-winners.ts), follows service conventions with a single exported 'run' function and Result-based error handling, maintains cohesion with all files reachable from index.ts, focuses on one capability (award selection), and uses a descriptive name that describes the capability rather than implementation.
